items.title_zh: “他对我说”对“Paltu Chacha”：尼蒂什·库马尔的“摇摆政治”引发幽默盛宴
items.title_en: 'He Nitished me' to 'Paltu Chacha': Nitish Kumar's 'swing politics' sparks humour fest
items.summary_zh: 尼蒂什·库马尔(Nitish Kumar)在比哈尔邦政坛与印度人民党组建新政府，引发社交媒体用户讽刺他频繁变换联盟和政治翻筋斗。双关语、漫画和有趣的电影典故都被用来嘲笑库马尔的决定。网民们戴上漫画帽子，参考企业界、电影和板球来制作自己的表情包。
items.summary_en: Nitish Kumar forms new government with BJP in Bihar politics, causing social media users to lampoon his frequent change in alliances and political somersaults. Wordplay, cartoons, and funny movie allusions were used to mock Kumar's decision. Netizens put their comic caps on and referenced the corporate world, cinema, and cricket to make their memes.

items.title_zh: 传单击中靛蓝航空飞行员宣布由于大雾天气航班延误，视频疯传
items.title_en: Flyer hits IndiGo Pilot announcing flight delay due to dense fog conditions, video goes viral
items.summary_zh: 乘客在延误通知期间袭击靛蓝航空飞行员；航空公司工作人员因长时间延误而面临的安全问题；乘客的行为在社交媒体上受到广泛谴责。
items.summary_en: Passenger assaults IndiGo flight pilot during delay announcement; safety concerns for airline staff amid extended delays; passenger's actions widely condemned on social media.
